tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows span only 0.018 in s_grad, so changes in rho can be offset by changes in vmax with little effect on the pilot fit. The 2.0-cost probe adds gradient variation to separate those parameters. Fit the resulting data over the full fallback box rather than imposing the narrow warm-start range.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot constrains the effective amplitude near s_grad = 1, but does not reliably separate vmax from rho for predictions at other gradients.
It costs more and targets temporal resolution rather than the missing gradient variation. The pilot already uses the target horizon.
All observed gradients are well below the indicated activation regime, so the pilot cannot identify an avalanche term.
